items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: She was watching over us and we didn't even know it. ... Margaret pulled out and took 3 of us home with her.

ctx.x: He got you and the other girls in a room?
In a room and he was giving us whiskey and Coca-Cola, and Margaret came in. He was just about to do his act, you know, and she came into the room. I was so sick.
